annotations.title: Employment contract terms in one canton

description: What the employment contract of a cleaner, nanny, carer or au pair in a Swiss private household has to say in one canton, from the canton's standard employment contract for household work (NAV / CTT / CNL) and the Code of Obligations: probation and its notice, notice after probation by service year, paid vacation weeks (by age), full-time week, overtime, night and Sunday supplements, paid public holidays, 13th month wage, hours register, maternity leave and sick pay in the first year. Every term carries its article and the instrument's verbatim sentence, and whether a written contract may deviate. Also what must be confirmed in writing (Art. 330b OR) and a link to Clino's free contract generator, prefilled with the figures given. Use it for 'write me an employment contract', 'what notice period applies', 'how many weeks of vacation', 'is overtime paid extra'.

canton.description: Swiss canton where the household lives: two-letter code (ZH, GE, VD...) or its name. The standard employment contract (NAV/CTT) of the WORKPLACE governs; that is this canton unless workplace_postcode places the work in another one.

hourly_wage_chf.description: Agreed gross hourly wage in CHF, to prefill the contract generator.

hours_per_week.description: Average weekly hours, to prefill the contract generator.

language.description: Language of the explanatory texts and of the clino.ch links: en, de, fr, it, es or pt. Default en.

lives_in.description: true if the worker lives in the household (board and lodging). Neuchâtel's standard contract only covers live-in staff, and Vaud gives them a longer notice.

monthly_wage_chf.description: Agreed gross monthly wage in CHF instead of an hourly wage (nanny, carer), or the au pair's pocket money.

role.description: What the worker does: cleaner, nanny (childcare), carer (care of an elderly or disabled person), au_pair or other. Sets which contract generator the link opens; au_pair in Geneva adds the au pair contract's own rules.

start_date.description: First working day, YYYY-MM-DD, to prefill the contract and date the end of the probation.

worker_age.description: Age of the worker in years, for the vacation entitlement (more weeks under 20 and, in some cantons, from 50 or 60). Never a birthdate.

workplace_postcode.description: 4-digit Swiss postcode (PLZ/NPA) of the WORKPLACE. City minimum wages (e.g. Stadt Luzern) depend on it.

name: get_contract_terms

au_pair_geneva.description: Only for an au pair working in Geneva: the CTT-TPMaj addendum.

canton.description: The canton whose standard employment contract governs (the workplace).

data_verified_on.description: Date the rate set was last checked against the official sources.

explanation.description: What binding means for the contract: which terms a written contract may change.

instrument.description: Official title of the canton's standard employment contract for household work (NAV / CTT / CNL), or null where none governs this relationship and only the Code of Obligations applies.

contract_generator.description: Clino's free contract generator for this role, prefilled with the figures given (no personal data in the link).

paperwork_help.description: Only relevant when the user asks who can prepare the contract, registration and payslips for them. Not an answer to any other question.

link.description: Clino page explaining how it works.

what.description: What Clino prepares, in the requested language. The household signs, submits and pays itself.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence of the source that states the value.

summary.description: Two or three sentences a person can read first.

full_time_week_hours.description: Normal full-time week under the instrument; null where it sets none.

steps.description: Notice in months to the end of a month, by service year (1 = first year).

no_supplement_exception.description: Hours on which the instrument itself owes no overtime supplement (ZH/OW part-time staff, UR part-timers, LU 43rd to 45th hour); null where supplement_percent applies to every hour above the contract.

ends_on.description: Last day of the probation, when a start date was given.

legal_basis.description: Article and instrument the value comes from, or the Code of Obligations article where the canton's contract is silent.

notice_days.description: Notice during probation, in calendar days.

quote.description: Verbatim sentence of the instrument that states the value; null where the Code of Obligations applies.

rules.description: The full scale: base, under 20 and any age or service steps.

weeks.description: Paid vacation weeks a year for this worker (with worker_age; else the adult base).

written_terms.description: What the employer must confirm in writing even without a signed contract.

title: Employment contract terms in one canton
